title: chrysosplenium lanuginosum var. ciliatum
intro: Chrysosplenium lanuginosum var. ciliatum, commonly known as  a type of flowering plant in the Saxifragaceae family. This plant is a variant of the Chrysosplenium lanuginosum species, characterized by its hairy leaves and ciliated stems. The health benefits of Chrysosplenium lanuginosum var. ciliatum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antiseptic effects.
